lăpĭo , īre, v. a. lapis,
I.to turn into stone, make hard like stone, to petrify, harden (ante-class.): “lapit significat obdurefacit et lapidem facit. Pacuvius Periboea: lapit cor cura,” Non. 23, 7 sq. (Pac. Fragm. Trag. v. 276 Rib.): lapit dolore afficit, Paul. ex Fest. p. 118 Müll.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
